label: Undo Dead — any family
notes: Byte-checked against UndoDead.csv (supplied 2026-09-30): BOM, CRLF, no trailing newline.
Applicable to devices at IDMS 9 (Dead). Moves them to IDMS 1 (New) — see the 9 -> 1 transition in config/lifecycle.json, which is itself marked uncertain.
The sheet has no Productcode column, although the request that introduced this format listed one. The sheet wins: it is what the parser accepted.
Device Type comes from the group's family via resolveDeadDeviceType, exactly as on the Dead sheet — same six-value vocabulary.

AccountId is the customer the device belonged to before its return — Asset.Prior_to_RMA_AccountId__c, read at generate time — NOT Asset.AccountId, which on a returned or dead device is the Install Check holding account. A device whose prior account is empty, or equal to its current account, is refused rather than written. See server/services/undo-dead-account.js.

UndoDead Reason has no default: the operator picks one per file. Only 'Lost & Found at Inventory' has been seen in an accepted sheet; the capitalisation of the other three is as supplied, unconfirmed against the parser.
